intro.text: The head quartermaster in Highprince Dalinar Kholin's warcamp, an Alethi of the tenth dahn.

items.text: Rind issued Kaladin and Bridge Four their armour and Cobalt Guard uniforms, and helped the men, used only to bridgeman's clothes, dress in them. He was surprised by a darkeyed captain but didn't object. When the men cut off the Cobalt Guard patches to stay Bridge Four, he agreed to commission new patches from a glyphpair Kaladin drew.
Puzzled by the request, he also made Kaladin a sturdy rope ladder for climbing down into the chasms.

appearance.text: A grizzled man with an enormous belly and a surprisingly high-pitched voice.
